name: get_rate
description: Get the current exchange rate between two currencies (e.g., USD, EUR). Returns the rate value and timestamp.

from.description: Source currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

to.description: Target currency code (e.g., EUR, JPY, CHF)

name: convert
description: Convert an amount from one currency to another at current rates. Returns the converted amount and the exchange rate applied.

name: get_historical_rate
description: Get the exchange rate between two currencies on a specific date (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the historical rate and date.

name: get_currencies
description: List all supported currencies with codes and full names. Use to verify currency codes before converting or checking rates.
